paragraphs.text: Presentation studio for DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, import and verify native PowerPoint decks.
# Deckforge
**The presentation layer for DeepSeek Harness.** One project, three loops — create, refine, deliver
— and gates that prove the file opens and reads correctly.
Deckforge builds native PowerPoint decks: text stays text, charts stay editable charts with their da
ta workbook embedded, and nothing is rasterised. It also exports a self-contained HTML deck that pre
sents offline, a PDF, page images, and a reproducible bundle.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Why another presentation tool
Existing DSH presentation plugins are strong at one loop each: pipelines generate well and cannot be
touched, workbenches edit well and cannot import, file editors patch a foreign deck and cannot crea
te. Deckforge runs all three loops on **one project**, with **one revision model** and **one receipt
orge runs all three loops on **one project**, with **one revision model** and **one receipt chain**.

- **Create.** Structured pages compile to OOXML with a theme, layout recipes and speaker notes.
- **
Refine.** Select an object, change it, see the diff, undo it — from the model or from the workbench.
- **Deliver.** Gates that name what was checked, on which bytes, with which engine. A missing rende
rer is a recorded skip, never a pass.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The bundle is plain ESM with node builtins only: no compiler, no Python environment, no native modul
e. LibreOffice and `pdftoppm` are optional and only affect the render gate.
Refresh the Harness window after installation and look for **Deck Studio** in the sidebar.
## Development
Use Node.js 22.19 or later. No dependency install or build step is required.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

GitHub Actions runs the English check and the test suite on Node.js 22 and 24.
The automated checks

cover the compiler, project operations and workbench registration/routes.
Manual verification on 202
6-10-31 confirmed the sidebar entry and workbench in the running local Harness web frontend: empty d
ecks, adding pages, switching between discovered projects, selecting text, quick edits, inspector re
fresh, history restore, checks, and PowerPoint/HTML export. Semantic requests are explicitly deferre
d to chat. This does not establish Microsoft PowerPoint compatibility; opening exports in Microsoft
PowerPoint remains a separate manual check.
## Sixty seconds
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The result is `decks/q3-review/export/q3-review-r2.pptx`, a file PowerPoint opens without a repair p
rompt, and an HTML deck that presents with arrow keys, `S` for notes and `Ctrl+P` to print.
## The tool surface
| Tool | Job |

| `deck_new` | Create a project with a theme, a venue and a slot. |
| `deck_plan` | Turn a venue and

a duration into a slide budget and a per-beat plan. |
| `deck_write` | Append pages from structured

content; layouts are inferred or named. |
| `deck_edit` | Atomic operations with a semantic diff: m

ove, restyle, align, add, delete, reorder. |
| `deck_import` | `.pptx` or Markdown in, project out,

with a loss report. |
| `deck_patch` | Surgical edits on a foreign `.pptx`: text, images, order, not

es. |
| `deck_splice` | Replace one slide and prove every other part is byte-identical. |
| `deck_ch

eck` | Schema, layout, content and compatibility gates without a renderer. |
| `deck_render` | Raste

r the real file, report pixel statistics and the visual diff. |
| `deck_review` | A repair plan — pr

oposed operations, never applied. |
| `deck_export` | pptx, html, pdf, png, notes, bundle; each with

a receipt. |
| `deck_status` | Revision, pages, receipts, engines, talk time. |
| `deck_verify` | R
e-hash a file and say whether its receipt still holds. |
## Quality gates
| Gate | Checks | Blocks export |

| G1 schema | types, ids, bounds, theme refs | yes |
| G2 layout | out-of-bounds, measured overflow,

overlap with declared exceptions, contrast, safe area, design budget | yes on errors |
| G3 content

| talk time against the slot, duplicate headlines, unsourced numbers | advisory |
| G4 render | Lib

reOffice raster of the actual file, blank-page detection | recorded, skipped when unavailable |
| G5

diff | ΔE against the previous render | advisory |
| G6 compat | the minimum Office version the fea
tures need | advisory |
Every gate writes a receipt: `{ gate, engine, engineVersion, input, output, findings, skipped, at }`
very gate writes a receipt: `{ gate, engine, engineVersion, input, output, findings, skipped, at }`.
## The project
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Rules: `1 px = 1 pt`, origin top-left, 960x540 default; page order is z-order; element ids survive i
mport and re-export; `manifest.revision` is the optimistic lock; every export records the SHA-256 of
the bytes it produced.
## Themes
Eight design systems: `slate`, `paper`, `midnight`, `ember`, `forest`, `mono`, `ocean`, `sand`. A th
eme is data — palette roles, a type scale, spacing and radius — and every surface (PowerPoint, HTML,
workbench) reads the same file.
## The workbench
**Deck Studio** is a panel in the Harness UI: a page strip, a vector canvas and an inspector. Drag a
n object to move it, edit text in place, change a style, add or reorder pages, switch theme, run the
gates and export. Every write goes through the same routes the tools use, so the workbench and the
model share one revision and one lock.
## English only
The repository is English-only by design: tools, skills, errors, docs, templates, tests. `npm run ch
eck:english` fails on any CJK codepoint. The model still answers in the user's language; the product
ls on any CJK codepoint. The model still answers in the user's language; the product speaks English.
## Compatibility

- PowerPoint 2010 or later reads every feature the compiler emits; 2007 reads all but WebP images.
-

LibreOffice renders the deck and is used by the render gate when present.
- No network at presentat
ion time: the HTML deck inlines its images and draws its charts as inline SVG.

at was studied and what was written fresh.
